settings.seed_control: single-panel arm rerun with sampler seed 2000 + rep (main runs use 1000 + rep)
settings.uncertainty: mean over replicates with Monte Carlo SE (SD / sqrt(n)); paired differences use the SE of the per-replicate difference; variance ratios use the log scale with delta-method SE

metric_definitions.ld_fit_excess: Gaussian LD-fit loss (ridge delta 0.001) of the method's LD matrix to the generating covariance of the null z-scores, minus the loss at the generating weight, per replicate
metric_definitions.null_var_pct: 100 * (exp(mean over replicates of log(variance of target scores / variance under EUR-only PRS-CS)) - 1), null GWAS; delta-method SE
metric_definitions.top10_pct: share of target individuals in the method's top score decile also in EUR-only PRS-CS's top decile, non-null GWAS
metric_definitions.cor: correlation of target scores with EUR-only PRS-CS scores, non-null GWAS
metric_definitions.r2: squared correlation between target scores and true genetic values, non-null GWAS
metric_definitions.seed_contrast: null score variance of the method relative to the EUR-only seed rerun (geometric mean percentage change); per-replicate difference between the method and the seed rerun in top10_pct (percentage points) and cor (x1000)

notes: Replicates missing an arm are dropped from that arm's paired comparisons; n per cell is in tables.tsv. Experiment runs were made on RedHawk with the null-simulation job scripts (cluster/jobs/null_sim, not version-controlled).
